parameters.jsCode:
// Auto-register new lead from WhatsApp
const msg = $input.first().json;

const leadId = 'BR-' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10).replace(/-/g,'') + '-' + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8).toUpperCase();

return [{
  json: {
    lead_id: leadId,
    name: msg.sender_name || 'WhatsApp Lead',
    email: '',
    phone: msg.phone,
    source: 'whatsapp',
    nationality: '',
    visa_type: '',
    english_level: '',
    preferred_date: '',
    stage: 'new_lead',
    score: 10,
    priority: 'medium',
    qualification_notes: 'Auto-registered via WhatsApp',
    created_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    next_follow_up: '',
    notes: 'First message: ' + msg.message_content.substring(0, 200),
    utm_source: 'whatsapp_organic',
    utm_campaign: '',
    lost_reason: '',
    referred_by: '',
    // Pass through for AI router
    original_message: msg.message_content,
    message_type: msg.message_type
  }
}];
